is_sarcastic.instructions: Is this game review written using sarcasm, irony, jokes, memes, or exaggerated humor rather than a literal critique?

labels.true: Sarcastic, ironic, joke, or meme review

criteria.false: The review expresses direct thoughts, actual feedback, or genuine praise/complaint without irony.
criteria.true: The review uses sarcasm, irony, absurd humor, memes, or exaggerated praise to mock or joke.
